title: Ab wida hota hai humse laal zehra ka
body:
AB WIDAH HOTA HAI HUM SE LAAL ZEHRA KA
KITNE KHUSH THEY MOULA YEH TERE CHAHNE WAALEY, AAAYE MEH’MAAN BANKER PHIR SEY KARBALA WAALEY, AB TUMHARE JAANE SEY DIL PA CHALTEY HAIN BHAALEY
DO MAHINE MAATAM KEY KITNE JALD BEETEY HAIN, RO NA PAAYE JI BHARKEY ISKA GHAM HAR EK PAL HAIN, KAR SAKEY NA KHIDMAT HUM YEH MA’LAAL DIL MEIN
MAJLIS-E-SHAHE DEEN MEIN FATIMA BHI AATI THI, ZEHMATEIN UTHATHI THI, AA’NSOON BHI BHATHI THI
<<DIVIDER>>
AUR DUA’EN BHI DEKAR IS AZA SE JAATHI THI
TERA GHAM MANANEY KOPAYEE ZINDAGI HUM NEY, GAR TERA NA GHAM HO TO KYA MAZAA HAI JEENEY MEIN, TERE GHAM SEY BAAQI HAI AAJ TAAZIYA KHANEY
DIL MEIN EK HASRAT HAI KARBALA PAHUNCH JAAYE, ROAZEY PA KAREIN MAATAM YEH MURAAD BAR AAYE, TUJH PA ROTEY ROTEY BAS JAAN YEH NIKAL JAAYE
AAJ HAR AZAKHANA KYON UDAAS DIKHTA HAI, DIL TADAP KEY RONEY KO BEKHARAR HOTA HAI, HUM SE MOOSAVI RUKHSAT SHAHE-DEEN HOTA HAI..
